svg.title: GitOps workflow diagram
svg.desc: Three-workflow GitOps flow: agent pushes to feature branch triggering clean and validate workflows, human merges PR, then main branch is overwritten for ArgoCD sync.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the agent push to the feature branch?')
sendPrompt('How does the dynamic clean overwrite workflow work?')
g.text: detect folder → purge → amend → force push

g.onclick: sendPrompt('When does the PR open in this flow?')
sendPrompt('How does the force-overwrite-main workflow detect which folder to overwrite?')
g.text: detect folder → wipe → pull feature → push

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does main look like after the overwrite?')
sendPrompt('How does ArgoCD detect and sync the change?')

svg.text: click any node to learn more
